messages:
alex_cs: Quick heads-up — Ember onboarding is hitting a burst of 429s on preflight during their QA ramp. They spun up ~50 parallel browser sessions and see ~20% of preflight calls fail with scope_concurrency errors.

marta_eng: Oof. Do we have a sample request/response and their org id? Any proxy in front of clients?

alex_cs: Org: org_ember_123. They mentioned a corporate proxy that reuses connections. Sample response they pasted: 

```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: req_01F...
X-Redwood-Retry-After: 12

{
  "error": "rate_limit",
  "reason": "scope_concurrency",
  "details": {"limit": 10, "window": "1s"}
}
```

alex_cs: Their frontend opens a preflight per tab and each tab re-auths (short ephemeral token ~30s). So lots of parallel preflight + ephemeral handshake.

marta_eng: That pattern will definitely fan out the preflight. Two immediate asks: 1) Can Ember reuse ephemeral tokens across tabs / extend token TTL? 2) We'll check whether our preflight concurrency window is too tight for small bursts behind proxies.

noah_sre: On our side — preflight concurrency limiter defaults to 10/s per org. For a sudden spike of 50 parallel tabs, that's going to throttle. Quick mitigation options:
- increase per-org burst for Ember temporarily
- bump token TTL or advise client reuse across tabs
- enable client-side jitter/backoff on preflight attempts

marta_eng: Can you bump the burst while they finish changes? Also we should surface a KB: "Best practices for browser preflight & ephemeral tokens".

noah_sre: I'll apply a temporary override for org_ember_123 to allow burst=150 for next 24h. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: edge-config: updated override org_ember_123 { preflight_burst: 150, expiry: "2026-03-22T03:10:00Z" } by noah_sre

alex_cs: Thanks — Ember will retest in ~10m. I'll post results. :thumbsup:

alex_cs: Update from Ember: after the override, their preflight 429s dropped to ~1.5% during the same ramp. They still have a few timeouts due to proxy connection reuse.

marta_eng: Good. Follow-ups:
- CS to ask Ember to re-use ephemeral token per browser session (or increase TTL to >=2m)
- Eng to add a prod-safe per-org preflight burst knob (persistent) + alert when preflight throttle rate > 2% for longer than 5m
- KB article with code snippet: how to reuse token across tabs (suggest indexedDB/sessionStorage pattern)

noah_sre: I'll open a short-lived incident playbook note and keep the override for 24h. If they make changes, we'll rollback the override.

alex_cs: I'll capture customer feedback and note renewal risk minimal — this is a classic onboarding spike. Thanks team.

marta_eng: Filing a follow-up ticket for product/console to expose the per-org preflight burst toggle and add docs.

alex_cs: Closing here unless anyone needs more from me. :coffee:
